semantics.composition_rule: Elements bind to existing values, schemas and canonical operations.
semantics.semantic_rule: Element type/presentation does not redefine source data semantics.
semantics.authority_rule: Element availability or enabled visual state does not grant authority.
semantics.extension_rule: New shared primitive is added when multiple surfaces benefit or an irreducible UI semantic is needed.

invariants.rule: Expose components reuse canonical semantics and remain non-privileged projection/composition surfaces.
